title.narrative: Supporting democratic stability through election-related conflict prevention in Peru

description.narrative: Contract related to: Supporting democratic stability through election-related conflict prevention in Peru - This 18-month exceptional assistance measure seeks to support Peru¿s democratic stability by enhancing the capacities of relevant stakeholders to proactively and effectively prevent, mitigate and peacefully address and manage election-related tensions and potential crises. To this effect, targeted technical support will be provided to the electoral management bodies (EMBs) to build their capacity to respond to the challenges of the electoral process, for instance in terms of public strategic communication, campaign financing, and electoral justice. At the same time, it will promote spaces of dialogue and communication with a view to helping enhance the trust of citizens and political actors in the integrity of electoral processes in Peru. Within this logic, the action will seek collaboration with civil society organisations and media in order to help mitigate political polarisation, enhance civic awareness and foster confidence in the integrity of the electoral process. Moreover, this measure will also aim to counter disinformation by empowering citizens, especially underrepresented groups, through digital literacy and democratic education in identifying and combating disinformation and harmful narratives online, while also improving coordination between media and electoral authorities.
